substitution.title: Substitution
substitution.description: Vervanging/waarneming registration: who covers an absent handler's workload, when, and for what scope. Domain data on top of OpenRegister RBAC; grants no permissions of its own (handler-vervanging-waarneming spec).

absentee.title: Absentee
absentee.description: Nextcloud user id of the handler being covered

substitute.title: Substitute
substitute.description: Nextcloud user id of the waarnemer

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First day of the absence period (inclusive)

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Last day of the absence period (inclusive); required

scopeRefs.title: Scope references
scopeRefs.description: caseType or case UUIDs when scope is narrowed

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Additional comment or note about this substitution

status.title: Status
status.description: ended is set lazily on resolution past endDate

createdBy.title: Created by
createdBy.description: User id that created the record (self-service or coordinator)

subject.nl: Je bent geregistreerd als waarnemer voor {{absentee}}
subject.en: You have been registered as waarnemer for {{absentee}}
